name: vidchopper-site
description: Canonical VidChopper product, release, and CLI documentation site.

scripts.build: npm run stage:assets && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/finalize-routes.mjs && node scripts/validate-routes.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run stage:assets && npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages && node scripts/finalize-routes.mjs --mode pages && node scripts/validate-routes.mjs --mode pages
